sources.title_original: Microsoft's Nadella bows to Trump's language diktat on "Super Intelligence" and uses it to attack OpenAI and Anthropic
sources.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella now calls artificial intelligence "super intelligence" instead of artificial intelligence, falling in line with Trump's preferred language. In his latest blog post, he frames AI models as insider security threats, taking yet another shot at OpenAI and Anthropic. The real motive is business: Microsoft risks falling behind as AI labs turn their models into the primary computer interface. The article Microsoft's Nadella bows to Trump's language diktat on "Super Intelligence" and uses it to attack OpenAI and Anthropic appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 微軟 執行長薩帝亞·納德拉（Satya Nadella）現在將人工智慧稱為「超級智慧」（super intelligence）而非人工智慧，藉此迎合川普偏好的用詞。在他的最新部落格文章中，他將 AI 模型描繪成內部的資安威脅，再次對 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 開砲。真正的動機是商業利益：隨著 AI 實驗室將其模型轉變為主要的電腦介面，微軟 面臨落後的風險。本文「微軟的 Nadella bows to Trump's language diktat on "Super Intelligence" and uses it to attack OpenAI and Anthropic」最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: 研究發現：AI 代理誇大其結果，距離自主研究仍相去甚遠 / AI agents overstate their results and remain far from autonomous research, study finds

sources.title_zh: 研究發現：AI 代理誇大其結果，距離自主研究仍相去甚遠
sources.title_en: AI agents overstate their results and remain far from autonomous research, study finds
sources.title_original: AI agents overstate their results and remain far from autonomous research, study finds
sources.summary: Epoch AI and Anthropic independently found the same thing: current AI models like GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5 can run experiments but lack scientific self-criticism and genuine creative thinking. At best, Sol reached 15 percent of the human reference score, and even that came from methods researchers already knew. The models' biggest weakness is still their inability to critically question their own results. The article AI agents overstate their results and remain far from autonomous research, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Epoch AI 與 Anthropic 獨立發現了相同的結論：目前的 AI 模型（如 GPT-5.6 Sol 與 Claude Fable 5）能夠執行實驗，但缺乏科學的自我批判與真正的創造性思考。充其量，Sol 只達到人類基準分數的 15%，且這還是透過研究人員已知的方法達成的。這些模型最大的弱點依然是無法對自己的結果進行批判性提問。文章〈研究發現：AI 代理誇大其結果，距離自主研究仍相去甚遠〉（AI agents overstate their results and remain far from autonomous research, study finds）最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Claude近期爆發封號潮，假期相關討論熱度破百萬，AI開發者集體炸鍋。起因是Anthropic七月舊報告被重新扒出並全網瘋轉：2026年上半年，Claude半年封禁1140萬個賬號，用戶提交39.8萬次申訴，僅4.2萬翻案。事件引發開發者對平臺封禁與申訴機制的強烈關注。

stories.title: AI 代理團隊浪費大量權杖，卻僅換取微乎其微的品質提升，研究發現 / AI agent teams waste massive tokens for barely measurable quality gains, research finds

sources.title: AI 代理團隊浪費大量權杖，卻僅換取微乎其微的品質提升，研究發現 / AI agent teams waste massive tokens for barely measurable quality gains, research finds
sources.title_zh: AI 代理團隊浪費大量權杖，卻僅換取微乎其微的品質提升，研究發現
sources.title_en: AI agent teams waste massive tokens for barely measurable quality gains, research finds
sources.title_original: AI agent teams waste massive tokens for barely measurable quality gains, research finds
sources.summary: Teams of AI agents barely outperform solo agents but cost up to 5.1x more, according to Vals AI. Only one out of four tests with GPT-6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 showed a measurable gain. Anthropic's own data backs this up: beyond ten agents, quality plateaus while token costs keep climbing. The article AI agent teams waste massive tokens for barely measurable quality gains, research finds appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據 Vals AI 的研究，AI 代理團隊的表現僅僅稍微優於單一代理，但成本卻高出最多 5.1 倍。在使用 GPT-6 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5 進行的四項測試中，只有一項顯示出可測量的增長。Anthropic's 自己的數據也支持這一點：在超過十個代理之後，品質會進入高原期，而權杖（token）成本則持續攀升。「AI 代理團隊浪費大量權杖，卻僅換取微乎其微的品質提升，研究發現」一文首先出現在 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: AI 購物新玩法引發爭議！馬斯克稱拍信用卡即可下單，遭 OpenAI 高管公開嘲諷
sources.summary: 埃隆·馬斯克在社交平臺公開介紹Grok機器人全新購物功能。按其說法，用戶只需隨手拍一張信用卡照片發送到聊天框，Grok就能自動全網搜索並對比商品最優價格，隨後直接替用戶完成下單。這一顛覆性便捷購物構想迅速引發科技界熱議，但其安全隱患也立刻招來同行質疑，OpenAI高管Tibo隨後在社交平臺對其提出質疑。

stories.title: 更便宜的 AI 權杖正推動更多需求，而這正是黃仁勳的最佳劇本 / Cheaper AI tokens are driving more demand, and that's Jensen Huang's best-case scenario

sources.title: 更便宜的 AI 權杖正推動更多需求，而這正是黃仁勳的最佳劇本 / Cheaper AI tokens are driving more demand, and that's Jensen Huang's best-case scenario
sources.title_zh: 更便宜的 AI 權杖正推動更多需求，而這正是黃仁勳的最佳劇本
sources.title_en: Cheaper AI tokens are driving more demand, and that's Jensen Huang's best-case scenario
sources.title_original: Cheaper AI tokens are driving more demand, and that's Jensen Huang's best-case scenario
sources.summary: Data from a16z shows a Jevons paradox in the AI market: token prices keep falling, but H100 GPU rental prices hold steady or climb. Cheaper AI drives demand faster than costs drop. If that demand flattens, the chain from chip makers to cloud providers takes a hit. The article Cheaper AI tokens are driving more demand, and that's Jensen Huang's best-case scenario appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: a16z 的數據顯示，AI 市場中存在傑文斯悖論（Jevons paradox）：權杖（token）價格持續下跌，但 H100 GPU 租賃價格保持穩定或攀升。更便宜的 AI 推動需求的成長速度大於成本下降的速度。如果這種需求趨於平穩，從晶片製造商到雲端服務供應商的整個產業鏈將受到衝擊。「更便宜的 AI 權杖正推動更多需求，而這正是黃仁勳的最佳劇本」一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

stories.title: 因 AI 論文海量湧入壓垮預印本伺服器，ArXiv 限制每月投稿上限為兩篇 / ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server

sources.title: 因 AI 論文海量湧入壓垮預印本伺服器，ArXiv 限制每月投稿上限為兩篇 / ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server
sources.title_zh: 因 AI 論文海量湧入壓垮預印本伺服器，ArXiv 限制每月投稿上限為兩篇
sources.title_en: ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server
sources.title_original: ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server
sources.summary: Starting October 2026, arXiv will cap submissions at two per person per month. Monthly submissions have doubled in two years, and in the cs.AI category they've grown more than sixfold. According to arXiv, a small fraction of authors are flooding the platform with low-quality papers, overwhelming its volunteer moderators. The article ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 從 2026 年 10 月開始，arXiv 將限制每人每月最多提交兩篇論文。每月提交量在兩年內翻了一倍，而在 cs.AI 分類中更是成長了六倍以上。根據 arXiv 的說法，極少數的作者正以低品質論文灌爆該平臺，讓其志工審查員應接不暇。本文「ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server」最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: 據《華爾街日報》，亞馬遜正與AI初創公司Decart洽談收購，潛在估值約70億美元（約469億元人民幣）。若談判順利且無新競購者，交易或很快達成。Decart總部在舊金山，其跨芯片適配技術是重要籌碼。在芯片荒與自研潮下，此舉折射出巨頭對算力控制權的焦慮。

sources.title_original: Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free
sources.summary: Odyssey is making its world model Odyssey-3 available as a public research preview. The 14-billion-parameter model generates interactive environments from text prompts in real time and can reportedly control robots, drones, and even GTA V. Odyssey claims top scores on physics benchmarks, though the methodology behind those results has limits. The article Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Odyssey 正在將其世界模型 Odyssey-3 以公開研究預覽的形式推出。這個擁有 140 億個參數的模型能從文字提示詞即時生成互動式環境，據報導還能控制機器人、無人機，甚至《GTA V》。Odyssey 宣稱其在物理基準測試中獲得最高分，儘管這些結果背後的方法論存在侷限性。這篇「Odyssey-3 是一個你可以免費試用的全新生成式世界模型」文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: 近日有讀者曬出實體書《終焉路獨行》中離譜一幕：懸疑靈異正文裏竟插入“需要我再微調部分語句，讓整體文風更貼合懸疑靈異的氛圍嗎？”這句AI助手口吻的話，瞬間破壞沉浸感。而該書網絡版第80章對應位置並無此句。消息迅速發酵，引發網友對實體書編校及AI介入的質疑。

stories.title: 蘋果招募由NotebookLM前員工合組的AI podcast App公司Huxe

sources.title_original: 蘋果招募由NotebookLM前員工合組的AI podcast App公司Huxe
sources.summary: 近日一份公告文件顯示，蘋果於今年春天招募了Google NotebookLM前團隊成員創立的AI podcast App業者Huxe核心成員並取得技術授權。 根據歐盟列出大廠申報的收購清單，蘋果在今年6月向Huxe AI提出員工招募提案，招募了特定員工，並獲得後者智財權的非獨家技術授權。 蘋果描述Huxe開發的是建造個人化音訊內容的手機應用程式。

sources.summary: 騰訊在微信生態上線AI創作撮合平臺“企鵝微單”，口號爲“說出你的需求，智能匹配創作搭子”。平臺連接AI創作需求方與手藝人，目前借國慶期間早期開放，公開通道已開放，全面開放時間未定。其本質是AI創作服務交易撮合，主要服務有商品圖、宣傳視頻需求的電商商家，以及需要短視頻內容等創作需求者。

sources.summary: 蘋果將於10月13日發佈新一代智能家居產品：搭載A18芯片的HomeView、S10芯片的新款HomePod mini和A19芯片的Apple TV。古爾曼10月12日透露，HomeView有桌面和壁掛版，配顯示屏，定位家庭智能控制中樞，預計11月中旬上市；另兩款10月30日開售，有望進一步整合蘋果智能家居生態。

sources.summary: 46歲數學家亞歷克斯·格爾科靠AI量化交易成英國頂級富豪。2026年《星期日泰晤士報》富豪榜中，他以160.06億英鎊（約1417.40億元人民幣）列第八，較2025年增72.61億英鎊，日均增約1989萬英鎊（約1.7億元人民幣）。他1979年生於莫斯科，獲莫斯科國立大學數學博士，研究交換代數等。

stories.title: 特朗普強推 AI 改名"超級智能"，硅谷巨頭排隊照辦

sources.title_original: 特朗普強推 AI 改名"超級智能"，硅谷巨頭排隊照辦
sources.summary: 特朗普推動把沿用數十年的“人工智能”（AI）改稱“超級智能”（SI）。他9月指責“人工”暗示虛假，簽署行政令要求聯邦機構官方通信改用SI，並威脅繼續稱AI者爲“敵人”。壓力滲入硅谷，馬斯克率先將SpaceXAI更名爲SpaceXSI，Salesforce貝尼奧夫緊隨其後。

sources.title: TII 發布 Falcon-ASR：16 億參數的阿拉伯語語音模型達到 20.92% 的 WER / TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER
sources.title_zh: TII 發布 Falcon-ASR：16 億參數的阿拉伯語語音模型達到 20.92% 的 WER
sources.title_en: TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER
sources.title_original: TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER
sources.summary: TII has released Falcon-ASR, a 1.6B speech recognition model for Arabic with an Emirati focus. It reports 20.92% average WER on 6 Arabic test sets, but weights and an API are not yet available. The post TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: TII 發布了 Falcon-ASR，這是一個具備阿拉伯聯合大公國特色、規模達 16 億參數的阿拉伯語語音辨識模型。它在 6 個阿拉伯語測試集上平均字詞錯誤率 (WER) 為 20.92%，但權重與 API 尚未推出。這篇文章 TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

sources.title: 什麼是 Decision 3.0？vLLM 語義路由器的全新開放決策模型 / What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models
sources.title_zh: 什麼是 Decision 3.0？vLLM 語義路由器的全新開放決策模型
sources.title_en: What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models
sources.title_original: What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models
sources.summary: vLLM Semantic Router released Decision 3.0, 5 Apache-2.0 multimodal decision models from 0.8B to 27B. They answer choice, yes/no and score questions about text and images in one call, without generating text. The post What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: vLLM 語義路由器（Semantic Router）發布了 Decision 3.0，包含 5 個規模從 0.8B 到 27B 的 Apache-2.0 多模態決策模型。它們能在單次呼叫中回答關於文字和圖片的選擇題、是/否題與評分問題，且不會生成文字。這篇部落格文章〈什麼是 Decision 3.0？vLLM 語義路由器的全新開放決策模型〉（What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models）最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

sources.summary: Cloudflare released Clef-omni, an Apache-2.0 multimodal decision model built on Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B. It scores text, images, audio and video in one call for $0.15 per million input tokens, while Clef-flash drops to $0.038. The post Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Cloudflare 發布了 Clef-omni，這是一個基於 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 構建的 Apache-2.0 多模態決策模型。它能在單次呼叫中對文字、圖片、語音和影片進行評分，每百萬個輸入 Token 的費用為 0.15 美元，而 Clef-flash 則降至 0.038 美元。這篇文章 Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。
